anleitung.unsichtbar: In Word: File → Info → Check for Issues → Inspect Document → remove “Hidden text”. White font: select text, set font colour to “Automatic” and review the content before deleting it.
anleitung.markierung: Home → Text Highlight Color → “No Color” (after Ctrl+A). Fill in highlighted placeholders first.
anleitung.korrektursprache: Ctrl+A → Review → Language → Set Proofing Language → English (UK); set the same language in the “Normal” style.
anleitung.noProof: Ctrl+A → Review → Language → clear “Do not check spelling or grammar”; also in the heading styles.
anleitung.kompatibilitaet: File → Info → Convert (compatibility mode), then check the layout.
anleitung.eigenschaften: File → Info → Properties: set the title; remove personal names via “Inspect Document → Document Properties and Personal Information”.
anleitung.kopfFuss: Open the header/footer of every section (including the last, often empty one), check “Link to Previous” and align revision/date.
anleitung.editionRevision: Align edition/revision on the cover, in headers/footers, in the record of revisions and in the file name.
anleitung.felder: Ctrl+A → F9 (update fields); for the table of contents choose “Update entire table”.
anleitung.fragmente: Delete the fragment on the cover/title page (show formatting marks with Ctrl+Shift+8).
anleitung.fremdsprache: Translate the paragraph or remove it as a working comment; comments belong in Word comments, not in the text.
anleitung.einschuebe: Replace the word with the English term.
anleitung.platzhalter: Replace placeholders with final values; keep fill-in lines only in forms and signature blocks.
anleitung.revisionsstand: Align revision and date in all headers/footers and on the cover.
anleitung.lep: Update the List of Effective Pages against the actual pages.
anleitung.seiten: Check page numbering (section breaks, “Start at”, “Page x of y”).
anleitung.revisionen: Add the current revision to the record of revisions; from the second revision on, include highlights of change.
anleitung.inhalt: Update the table of contents (Word: Ctrl+A → F9) and align the headings.
anleitung.nummerierung: Make numbering of headings, figures and tables consecutive.
anleitung.querverweise: Correct the target or insert it again as a cross-reference (Insert → Cross-reference).
anleitung.abkuerzungen: Add missing entries to the abbreviation list or remove unused ones.
anleitung.resteHoch: Review → Accept/Reject all changes; delete comments; reinsert broken references and press Ctrl+A → F9.
anleitung.glossar: Replace the variant with the preferred spelling (Word: Ctrl+H, enable “Match case” and “Find whole words only”).
anleitung.abkuerzungsliste: Add the abbreviation to the reference list or spell it out in the text.
anleitung.register: Correct revision/date in the document or in the document register — one of them is outdated.
anleitung.registerFehlt: Add the document to the document register or check the document number/title in the document and in the register.
anleitung.kennungen: Check the identifier against the reference list (typo or missing entry).
anleitung.summen: Recalculate the total and correct either the total row or the incorrect row. Use a formula (Word: =SUM(ABOVE) field, Excel: SUM) so the total follows later changes.
anleitung.kumuliert: Recalculate the cumulative time from the first deviating row onwards — the following rows build on it and are usually affected too.
anleitung.session: Adjust the time blocks or the stated session duration until both match (count briefing and debriefing if the duration includes them).
anleitung.einheiten: Recalculate the converted value with the exact factor and correct it (1 ft = 0.3048 m, 1 lb = 0.4536 kg, 1 NM = 1.852 km, 1 kt = 1.852 km/h, °F = °C × 1.8 + 32).
anleitung.metar: Make the weather report of the scenario internally consistent: choose visibility, present weather, temperature/dew point and vertical visibility to match each other. The finding names the contradiction.
anleitung.doppelt: Delete the repeated word or waypoint.
anleitung.uebung: Correct the exercise number in the reference or add the missing exercise to the exercise list.
anleitung.zirkel: Write out the content in one of the sections and refer to it only from the others.
anleitung.regelids: Check the rule reference against the loaded regulation and correct the identifier — if the finding names a nearest existing rule, check that one first.
anleitung.absaetze: Check the paragraph against the regulation and correct it — the finding lists the existing paragraphs.
anleitung.regelQuelle: Load the regulation into the library so the references can be verified, or verify them manually against the version in force.
anleitung.listeFehlt: Submit the appendix/annex with the package or mark the list entry as “Reserved”.
anleitung.listeTitel: Align the title in the document and in the list of appendices and annexes of the main document.
anleitung.listeNachtragen: Add the document to the list of appendices and annexes of the main document.
anleitung.paketStand: Align revision or date with the main document, or confirm that the package is intentionally submitted with different revisions or dates.
anleitung.hierarchie: If both documents refer to the same scope, align the value in the lower-level document with the higher-level document; otherwise state the scope explicitly.
anleitung.geschwisterSchreibweise: Use one spelling in all sibling documents — the one used elsewhere in the package, where the finding names it.
anleitung.geschwisterAbsatz: Align the paragraphs or confirm that the difference between the versions is intended.
anleitung.gegenfassung: Replace the term with the one of this version or delete the sentence — it is left over from the other version.
anleitung.propagation: Apply the correction confirmed in the sibling document here as well.
anleitung.paketVerweisArt: Correct the reference so that it names the document contained in the package (Annex or Appendix).
anleitung.paketVerweisZiel: Correct the chapter or exercise number in the reference or add the target to the referenced document.
anleitung.paketVerweisFehlt: Add the referenced document to the package or the library so the reference can be verified, or verify it manually.

referenz.hinweis: Excel, CSV or Markdown with a header row: glossary, abbreviations, document register (revision/date) or identifiers. Every review document is checked against them; nothing is stored.
referenz.unbekannt: {{name}}: columns not recognised – choose the type and assign the columns

recheck.einleitung: Re-check an external finding list (Excel or CSV from the team, an authority or an audit) against the current review package. The search covers the whole package, not just the page given — page numbers in the list refer to the previous revision. Like all documents, the list stays in this tab only.
recheck.drop: Drop the finding list here or choose a file (XLSX, CSV)
recheck.format: {{name}} could not be read — XLSX or CSV expected.
recheck.profilGeladen: Column mapping taken from the saved list profile
recheck.ohneKopf: No header row found: the list is read from the first row. Please map the columns – the options show examples from the first row. Without a header row no list profile is saved, and writing back into the file is not possible.
recheck.spaltenHinweis: Suggested from the column headers. When the check starts, the mapping is saved as a list profile and reused the next time the same list is imported — only column numbers are stored, no content.
recheck.befundFehlt: Without a “Finding text” column there is nothing to re-check.
recheck.dokHinweis: Each value of the “Document / area” column points to a review document, to the whole package or to a missing source. If the source is missing, the proposal is “Not verifiable” — nothing is guessed.
recheck.aufgehoben_one: 1 confirmation withdrawn – the proposal has changed.
recheck.aufgehoben_other: {{count}} confirmations withdrawn – the proposal has changed.
recheck.veraltet: The package or the mapping has changed since the check — please check again. Confirmations stay as long as the proposal for their row stays the same.

grund.wegUndDa: The text objected to no longer occurs anywhere in the package; the required text is present.
grund.restAnderesDok: Fixed in the referenced document, but still present in another document of the package.
grund.teilweise: Partly implemented; some variants or additions are still missing.
grund.unveraendert: None of it has been implemented.
grund.nurEmpfehlung: Raised as a recommendation (“could”, “consider”) and not implemented — closing requires a justification.
grund.quelleFehlt: The referenced document is not in the package.
grund.keinText: The document has no searchable text — run OCR first.
grund.keineAnweisung: No quoted text against which the correction could be checked. Content findings will be checked by the AI later; until then, review them manually.
grund.nurAbwesend: The quoted text no longer occurs – which does not show that the issue itself is resolved. Check individually; excluded from bulk confirmation.

recheck.folgt: Next: AI check of content findings.

rs.titel: Write back to the original file
rs.hinweis: DocCheck sets the status column to the confirmed value from the list's own value list and adds a remark column on the right. Everything else stays as it is — drop-downs, conditional formatting, charts. The original is not overwritten: a new file with the date in its name is created.
rs.ohneStatus: No status column mapped — only remarks will be written.
rs.nurBestaetigt: Unconfirmed proposals are left out — in the original a proposal would look like a decision.
rs.veraltet: Check again first: the proposals predate the last change to the package, mapping or targets – only a current state is written back.
rs.fehler: The file could not be written — the original is unchanged.
rs.neuNummern_one: Number {{von}}, following the highest number in the list. In the list’s style: header, drop-downs, colours, filter, A4 landscape.
rs.neuNummern_other: Numbers {{von}} to {{bis}}, following the highest number in the list. In the list’s style: header, drop-downs, colours, filter, A4 landscape.
rs.neuKeine: DocCheck found nothing in the package that is not already in the list.
rs.neuAusgenommen_one: 1 finding left out: it is a remaining occurrence of an old finding and is listed in its remark.
rs.neuAusgenommen_other: {{count}} findings left out: they are remaining occurrences of old findings and are listed in their remarks.

mobil.leer: No re-check in this session yet. It is started on the desktop; afterwards the proposals can be viewed and confirmed here.
mobil.startDesktop: Loading the list and starting the check: desktop only.

freigabe.begruendungFehlt: Please enter a justification (at least 5 characters).

paket.leer: No review documents read yet. Load the package in the left column — abbreviation, level and sibling groups are prefilled from file name and title.
paket.hinweis: Level 1 is the highest level (e.g. TM). If a lower-level document contradicts a higher one, the finding is raised against the lower one. Documents in the same group are siblings (e.g. multi-/single-pilot version); the variant decides which terms are allowed there.
paket.befunde_one: {{count}} package finding — see the Findings tab.
paket.befunde_other: {{count}} package findings — see the Findings tab.
